title: Snowmen with Cathedral Calendar
description: Mixed-media collage featuring multiple hand-drawn snowman figures arranged around a central red-bordered calendar image of a Gothic cathedral. Compact discs line the lower register alongside a child's crayon drawing labeled 'DADDY,' with a top-down warplane silhouette visible near the midpoint.
composition: vertical central panel flanked by snowmen and discs
keywords: snowman figure collage with compact discs
